title: Generative Models, Humans, Predictive Models: Who Is Worse at High-Stakes Decision Making?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting generative models to predict recidivism (using the COMPAS dataset format) with and without explicit defendant race information in the text, as well as with and without demographic-matched photos, then evaluating the Proportion of Positive Occurrence (PPO), accuracy, and refusal rates stratified by specific racial groups (Black, White, and Hispanic).
